inflation_usd_intro_1: Ngati mukusunga mu madola a U.S., mwina mwazindikira kuti ndalama zanu zikhoza kugula zochepa. Mukufunika madola a U.S. yochuluka kuti mugule zinthu zomwezo. Mukufunika madola a U.S. yochuluka kuti mukhalebe ndi moyo wamtundu womwewo.

inflation_usd_proof_p3: Ndalama zambiri zikamapangidwa kuchokera ku zopanda kanthu, zinthu zonse zimakwera mtengo. Kuphatikizapo zinthu zopangira zomwe makampani amagula popanga zinthu — zomwe zikutanthauza mitengo yokwera kwa inu.

inflation_usd_proof_p5_before: Ngati simungathe kukongola, simungathe kugwiritsa ntchito ndalama. Koma boma likamakhala

inflation_usd_btc_p2_before: Dola ya U.S. ili ndi kuchuluka kopanda malire, zomwe zikutanthauza kuti pamakhalapo zambiri zomwe zingasindikizidwe.
inflation_usd_btc_p2_after: , chifukwa kuchuluka kwake kwakukulu ndi 21 miliyoni ya Bitcoin. Palibe amene angasindikize Bitcoin yowonjezeka.
inflation_usd_btc_p3: M'mbuyomu, Bitcoin yawonjezera mphamvu zogula pakapita nthawi, pomwe dola ya u.s. ikutaya mphamvu yake yogula. Anthu ambiri amagwiritsa ntchito Bitcoin ngati akaunti yosungira kwa nthawi yayitali — ndalama zomwe amasunga zaka zambiri popanda kuzigwira pomwe mtengo wake ukukwera.
inflation_usd_btc_p4: Ndi chiyani chomwe mungafune kwambiri: kusunga mu madola a U.S. — madola a U.S. omwe akhoza kugula zochepa pakapita nthawi — kapena kusunga mu Bitcoin, yomwe m'mbuyomu yakhoza kugula zochuluka pakapita nthawi?

inflation_usd_freedom_p2: Lero, anthu padziko lonse akugwiritsa ntchito Bitcoin kuti ateteze ufulu wawo — ngakhale pamene maboma awo akukana kuwathandiza kapena kuyesa kuwaletsa.
inflation_freedom_decentralized_desc: Palibe gulu limodzi — palibe boma, palibe kampani — lomwe limalamulira Bitcoin.
inflation_freedom_permissionless_desc: Aliyense, kulikonse, akhoza kulowa nawo netiweki. Palibe amene angakuletse.
inflation_freedom_sovereign_desc: Dongosolo latsopano, lomasuka kuchokera kwa ndale ndi malonjezo awo opanda kukwaniritsidwa.
inflation_freedom_scarce_desc: Sipangakhale Bitcoin yopitirira 21 miliyoni. Palibe amene angasindikize yowonjezeka.
inflation_story_canada_desc: Antchito anagwiritsa ntchito Bitcoin kupeza ndalama zawo akaunti zawo zitatsekedwa.
inflation_story_nigeria_desc: Anthu ochita ziwonetsero anagwiritsa ntchito Bitcoin kupereka ndalama ku gulu lawo mabanki atadula mwayi wawo.
inflation_story_texas_desc: Kuthamanga Bitcoin kumathandiza kusunga magetsi pa nthawi ya mphepo yamkuntho yayikulu.
inflation_story_pennsylvania_desc: Kuthamanga Bitcoin kumatsuka zinyalala za malasha zomwe boma silinkafuna kuthana nazo.

inflation_nzd_proof_p3: Ndalama zambiri zikamapangidwa kuchokera ku zopanda kanthu, zinthu zonse zimakwera mtengo. Kuphatikizapo zinthu zopangira zomwe makampani amagula popanga zinthu — zomwe zikutanthauza mitengo yokwera kwa inu.
inflation_nzd_proof_p4: Ngongole ya boma ikamawonjezeka, amasindikiza ndalama zambiri chifukwa anthu ochepa amafuna kukongoza ndalama ku boma.
inflation_nzd_proof_p5_before: Ngati simungathe kukongola, simungathe kugwiritsa ntchito ndalama. Koma boma likamakhala
inflation_nzd_proof_p6: Ngongole zambiri za boma zikutanthauza kusindikiza ndalama zambiri. Kusindikiza ndalama zambiri kukutanthauza kukwera kwa mitengo kowonjezeka. Ndipo palibe mathero owoneka.
inflation_nzd_btc_p1: Kukwera kwa mitengo kumatanthauza kuti ndalama zanu zimakhoza kugula zochepa pakapita nthawi. Bitcoin ndi ndalama yabwino chifukwa ilibe kukwera kwa mitengo.
inflation_nzd_btc_p2_before: Dola ya New Zealand ili ndi kuchuluka kopanda malire, zomwe zikutanthauza kuti pamakhalapo zambiri zomwe zingasindikizidwe.
inflation_nzd_btc_p2_after: , chifukwa kuchuluka kwake kwakukulu ndi 21 miliyoni ya Bitcoin. Palibe amene angasindikize Bitcoin yowonjezeka.
inflation_nzd_btc_p3: M'mbuyomu, Bitcoin yawonjezera mphamvu zogula pakapita nthawi, pomwe dola ya new zealand ikutaya mphamvu yake yogula. Anthu ambiri amagwiritsa ntchito Bitcoin ngati akaunti yosungira kwa nthawi yayitali — ndalama zomwe amasunga zaka zambiri popanda kuzigwira pomwe mtengo wake ukukwera.
inflation_nzd_btc_p4: Ndi chiyani chomwe mungafune kwambiri: kusunga mu madola a New Zealand — madola a New Zealand omwe akhoza kugula zochepa pakapita nthawi — kapena kusunga mu Bitcoin, yomwe m'mbuyomu yakhoza kugula zochuluka pakapita nthawi?
inflation_nzd_freedom_p1: Netiweki ya Bitcoin sili ya munthu aliyense. Palibe boma kapena kampani yomwe imayilamulira. Idamangidwa kuti iteteze ufulu wanu ndi ndalama zanu.
inflation_nzd_freedom_p2: Lero, anthu padziko lonse akugwiritsa ntchito Bitcoin kuti ateteze ufulu wawo — ngakhale pamene maboma awo akukana kuwathandiza kapena kuyesa kuwaletsa.
